positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
My Independent consultancy - I helped early-stage startups ranging from consumer fintech, AI, and B2B SaaS as a product-focused, full-stack software engineer.

I specialized in shipping fast and helping teams hit milestones to get key customers and unlock fundraising, without needing to hire full-time devs.

Sometimes, I'd be invited to join full-time to be more deeply integrated with the team.

projects.title: Anthony's Anagrams
projects.description:
- Developed a game where the user creates as many words as possible in 60 secs. Used React with TypeScript, along with react-jss for styles and Firebase for storing game data.

- Implemented the Fisher–Yates shuffle algorithm, for generating a random permutation of a finite sequence, to shuffle the letters of the words used in the game.

- Implemented the Set data structure to store strings of all word possibilities for answer validation.
